text:
Type: slim gooseneck LED floor reading lamp
Use: focused reading light beside a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: thin black metal pole, flexible gooseneck neck, small LED spotlight head, round weighted base, foot switch on the cord
Colors: matte black
Shape: very tall thin stem that ends in a hooked gooseneck curve, tiny adjustable bell head, small round base, extremely light and linear, almost invisible
Feel: sleek, discreet, graphic
Goes with: black accents, white walls, light wood, grey upholstery; minimalist, Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: JANSJ
product.description: The LED light source consumes up to 85% less energy and lasts 20 times longer than incandescent bulbs.
